description: Pack supplied rectangles in input order by deterministic lowest skyline placement.
output_invariants: Detached input-order placements and ascending original unplaced indices.

behavior.validation: Accept exactly the required schema keys in plain passive JSON-compatible objects and dense ordinary arrays, with finite binary64 values and safe integer descriptors; no coercion, defaults, accessors, booleans-as-numbers or retained aliases. Complete static shape/value validation precedes work preflight. Geometric/topology tests run after preflight. Failure throws Error with stable code, no partial result. Outputs are detached. Canonicalize exposed signed zero to +0. Array lengths must fit 4294967295; unsafe requested growth/work arithmetic gives WORK_LIMIT before allocation. Host resource exhaustion is a host error, not an allocation guarantee.
behavior.environment: No ambient RNG, noise, clock, renderer, assets or retained state. All geometry uses caller coordinates; p5 examples use their own canvas convention. Randomness, where present, is explicit input/output rngState.
behavior.numerics: Separate IEEE754 binary64 arithmetic, Math.hypot and host sin/cos/sqrt for the named formulas. Check computed numeric intermediates for finiteness and throw NUMERIC_OVERFLOW on nonfinite results. No epsilon in classification or topology, no adaptive exact predicates or near-degeneracy guarantee. General scalar/coordinate comparisons allow absolute 1e-9 plus relative 1e-12; topology, indices, order, booleans and RNG states compare exactly. Analytical shared fixtures use exact JSON output.
behavior.algorithm:
Input: width,height (>0), rectangles (array {width,height} both >0), maxWork.
Output: {placements,unplaced}; placement {index,x,y,width,height}, unplaced is
ascending original indices. Process rectangles in supplied order, no rotation,
padding or implicit sorting. Skyline initially one horizontal span [0,width] at
y=0. Candidate x positions are each current span's start. Candidate y is maximum
height of skyline spans with left < x+rect.width and right > x (positive-width overlap only). Reject right/bottom
overflow. Select smallest y+rect.height, then smallest x. Insert the new top
height across its width, retaining left/right fragments, and merge adjacent
equal-height spans. Failure places nothing and preserves skyline; continue.
Coordinates at touching boundaries count as fitting. Returned placement order
is input processing order with failures omitted. Preflight 8*N*N*N+N <= maxWork, covering the naive candidate/span scan.
This is a deterministic heuristic, not globally optimal bin packing.
behavior.native_surface: p5.js named export skylinePack2D(input) from packages/javascript/src/skyline-pack-2d.js. Other targets deferred.
behavior.placement_order: No rotation, sorting or implicit padding. Return placed records in original processing order and unplaced IDs ascending. Reject nonfinite fit arithmetic even for a candidate that would not fit. Do not count zero-width span-boundary touching as overlap.
